segments.sn22.8:1.3: Taṃ suṇātha … pe … kathañca, bhikkhave, upādāparitassanā hoti?
segments.sn22.8:1.5: Idha, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano rūpaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.sn22.8:1.6: Tassa taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti.
segments.sn22.8:1.8: Vedanaṃ etaṃ mama … pe … saññaṃ etaṃ mama … saṅkhāre etaṃ mama … viññāṇaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.sn22.8:1.12: Tassa taṃ viññāṇaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti.
segments.sn22.8:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.sn22.8:2.3: Tassa taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti.
segments.sn22.8:2.5: Vedanaṃ netaṃ mama … saññaṃ netaṃ mama … saṅkhāre netaṃ mama … viññāṇaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.sn22.8:2.9: Tassa taṃ viññāṇaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti.

lines: Iti paṭipāṭiyā catūsu suttesu vaṭṭavivaṭṭameva kathitaṃ.
Taṇhāmānadiṭṭhivasena desanā katā “etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā”ti desanāya āgatattā.
